WITH cust AS (
  SELECT "customer_id", COUNT(*) AS order_cnt, SUM("amount") AS total_amount
  FROM "ecommerce_orders_f06afcec"."data"

)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_cnt >= 2) AS repurchase_customers,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_cnt >= 2) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repurchase_rate_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(order_cnt), 2) AS avg_orders_per_customer,
  MAX(order_cnt) AS max_orders

  SELECT "customer_id", COUNT(*) AS order_cnt

)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN order_cnt = 1 THEN '1次'
    WHEN order_cnt = 2 THEN '2次'
    WHEN order_cnt = 3 THEN '3次'
    WHEN order_cnt = 4 THEN '4次'
    ELSE '5次及以上'
  END AS order_bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS customer_cnt
FROM cust
GROUP BY order_bucket
ORDER BY order_bucket

WITH cust AS (
  SELECT "customer_id", "region", COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
  FROM "ecommerce_orders_f06afcec"."data"
  GROUP BY "customer_id", "region"
)

  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_cnt >= 2) AS repurchase_customers,
